notable_absence.finding: 'Note that there is no CLI support for the administration of specific indexes.' and separately 'Note that there is no REST API support for the administration of specific indexes.' Both the CLI and REST API sections of this page explicitly disclaim management of individual indexes (as against Index-Service-wide settings, which both surfaces do support) - the Web Console UI's Drop/Open-in-Workbench actions and SQL++ DDL are the only two ways to act on one specific index by name.

cross_component_finding: Opening an index in the Query Workbench 'cannot change the definition of the existing index, but you can create a new index with the modified definition' - there is no in-place ALTER-by-redefinition path from the UI at all; the only way to change what an index does is to create a differently-defined index and (implicitly) drop the old one.
